tasks: What kind of bird is the main character?
hints: A person who makes good decisions. (एक व्यक्ति जो अच्छे निर्णय लेता है।)
It is a green bird that can talk. (यह एक हरा पक्षी है जो बात कर सकता है।)

tasks: What did the parrot pretend to be to escape from the cage?
Why did the bird-catcher let the parrot out of the cage?
hints: He acted like he was not alive. (उसने ऐसा नाटक किया जैसे वह जीवित न हो।)
He thought the parrot was useless now. (उसने सोचा कि तोता अब बेकार है।)

tasks: What is the lesson we learn from the Wise Parrot?
If you were the parrot, would you stay in a golden cage with good food or fly away? Why?
hints: Thinking can solve big problems. (सोच बड़ी समस्याओं को हल कर सकती है।)
Compare comfort with freedom. (आराम की तुलना स्वतंत्रता से करें।)
